title: Game Designer
summary: Game designers decide how a game plays: its rules, core loop (the action players repeat), levels, rewards and in-game economy. They work with programmers, artists and product managers, prototype ideas, test them with players and keep tuning live games with events and balance changes.
dailyDuties: Write and update design documents for new features
Tune rewards and economy numbers in balancing spreadsheets
Build or adjust levels and test their difficulty
Prototype a mechanic in the game engine
Run playtests and sort player feedback
Plan the next live event or season with the product team
Review analytics and A/B test results for released features

skills.expectation: Design core loops and mechanics and write clear game design documents
Design progression, rewards and economy, and balance them in spreadsheets
Lay out levels or puzzles with good pacing and difficulty curves
Prototype and tune features yourself in a game engine
Prototype and tune features yourself in a game engine
Run playtests and turn player feedback into design changes
Design events, offers and seasons that keep a live game fresh
Build balancing and economy models in Excel or Google Sheets
Pitch ideas and explain designs to artists, programmers and product managers
Read A/B test and game analytics results to tune features
Pull player data to check how a feature performs
Script simple gameplay in C# for prototypes
Mock up screens and flows for features

certifications.why: Shows you can script prototypes in Unity; it is a programming cert, not a design one
